messages:
Priya (Design): Quick thread — new idea: rename the in-row 'Burst' control to 'Burst buffer' to imply temporary headroom. Sketch uploaded. Key asks: 1) clarify SLO slider deadzone vs exact target (users confuse small drags), 2) min/max labels need clearer tooltip copy, 3) make burst buffer state reachable via keyboard in one tab. Thoughts?
Noah (Frontend): I like the naming change, but note it affects telemetry labels and CSS classnames. For the slider deadzone we can implement snap-to-step plus a small numeric input that toggles on edit. That avoids accidental micro-drags.
Ava (A11Y): Agree on numeric input fallback. Accessibility notes: for screen readers use aria-valuetext like "SLO target 300ms, preset: balanced". Announce when the slider enters the deadzone: "SLO at preset threshold". Ensure the burst button is focusable and has aria-pressed.
Sam (PM): Product constraints: defaults must remain cost-protective. If buffer >40% show inline guardrail: "Higher buffer increases cost — see estimate." Also prefer language that frames upgrade options as "view options" rather than "upgrade".
Jae (Eng): Backend concerns: we'll need to map new name to existing API field (burst_quota). We'll accept both keys for a migration window. Also enforce server-side validation: min <= max and buffer <= pool_max_gpus. Return a soft-warning flag when buffer approaches pool_max.
Priya (Design): Microcopy for tooltips: min/max -> "Min: guaranteed GPUs. Max: soft ceiling for autoscale." Burst buffer tooltip -> "Temporary extra GPUs for spikes (billed while active)." For deadzone microcopy: "Snap to preset unless you choose Edit".
Noah (Frontend): Implementation plan: slider snaps to presets; small 'Edit' icon reveals numeric input and the min/max steppers. DOM order: pool picker -> burst buffer toggle -> SLO slider -> min/max. I'll add role=\"slider\" + aria-valuetext and a polite aria-live for cost updates.
Ava (A11Y): Good. Also require visible focus styles and ensure all state isn't only color. Add keyboard hint text for each control.
Sam (PM): UX decision: use "view options" copy for nudge: "This SLO may need more capacity 12 view options." Keep guardrail conservative at 40% buffer.
Jae (Eng): We'll feature flag as autoscale-buf-v1, debounce cost calls to 350ms, and emit analytics events: buffer_open, buffer_override, slo_edit.
